## ME414 — Statistics for Experimentalists

**Teaching Assistant — Programa de Estágio Docente (PED)**  
Instituto de Matemática, Estatística e Computação Científica (IMECC), University of Campinas (UNICAMP), Brazil  
March–June and August–December 2026

- Regular office hours covering probability distributions, estimation, hypothesis testing, regression, and analysis of variance.
- Selected lectures and guided problem-solving sessions on statistical inference and related course topics.
